name: Rico Outlook Mail Monitor
description: Private exact-folder and exact-sender Outlook metadata monitor with fail-closed iMessage delivery.

enabled.description: Explicitly activates the 90-second monitor after its private adapter and grant are installed.

adapterModule.description: Absolute path to an operator-reviewed 0600 Outlook/iMessage adapter module.

permissionFile.description: Absolute path to the private 0600 exact-authority grant.

stateDirectory.description: Absolute private directory for cursors and immutable-ID dedupe state.
